text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 100,994 to 94,144 before recovering partway, so I should expect short-term volatility and avoid panic decisions based on one month.","Doing nothing avoided impulsive trades, but holding without review is not a strategy; I should periodically check whether my allocation still fits my goals and risk tolerance.","I want to buy an apartment within ten years, so I should follow a steady savings and investing plan rather than chase quick gains or assume recent performance will continue."]}
